_help: "answer" is the number of the correct option, counting from 1. You can add or remove questions and options; the build checks that every answer number is valid.

questions.question: What best describes a bud bar business?
options: A retail store that sells cannabis products
A mobile cannabis service that staffs and runs a bar setup at private events
A cannabis farm that sells wholesale
questions.feedback: A bud bar sells a service at private events: setup, trained staff, education, and the guest experience.

questions.question: Which group is the best source of repeat bookings?
questions.feedback: Planners and event producers book many events a year. One good relationship can mean steady work.

questions.question: Which bud bar business model is allowed?
options: The service-fee / BYO model is allowed everywhere
The licensed operator model is allowed everywhere
It depends on state and local rules, so you must confirm before taking deposits
Any model is allowed if the venue agrees
questions.feedback: Which model is allowed depends on the state, and city or county rules can be stricter. Confirm before you take a deposit.

questions.question: An event brings in $1,500 in revenue and costs $650 to run. What is the profit for that event?
Your startup costs are $4,000 and you make $800 profit per event. About how many events until you earn back your startup costs?
questions.feedback: Break-even = startup costs ÷ profit per event. $4,000 ÷ $800 = 5 events.
